sloka: सत्यम् आगम योगेन मम एष विदितो हरिः ।न अस्य शक्यम् बलम् रूपम् प्रभावो वा अनुभाषितुम् ॥६-२८-१६॥।।
transliteration: satyam āgama yogena mama eṣa vidito hariḥ ।na asya śakyam balam rūpam prabhāvo vā anubhāṣitum ॥6-28-16॥।।

translations.english: "I came to know about him through one of my contacts. His strength, his appearance and glory are indescribable."
